description:
Dungeon logic puzzle: find the walls from the row and column counts Oubliettes is a logic puzzle. Each grid hides a dungeon: work out where every wall is from the clues, with no guessing needed. Every grid has exactly one solution. Rules
  • The numbers along the edge give the number of walls in each row and column.
  • Monsters and chests are never walls.
  • Every monster sits in a dead end, and every dead end holds a monster.
  • Every chest is in a treasure room: 3×3 open cells, one chest, one opening.
  • Elsewhere, hallways are one cell wide and the whole dungeon is connected.
Features
  • Campaign: 250 levels that are the same for everyone, in five difficulties (6×6 to 14×14), all open from the start.
  • Endless: randomly generated grids in the difficulty you pick.
  • Tutorial: a dungeon you solve step by step, one rule at a time.
  • Drag to fill a row or column, undo and redo, progress and history saved after every move.
  • Screen reader support, a magnifier for large grids, plain digits and a calm mode without animation.
  • Endless grids are generated on the device. No ads, no tracking, no account.
  • Original medieval music loops and sound effects, with volume sliders.
The app never uses the network: it does not ask for the Internet permission.
